subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: you look a little bit like my mother he said especially in the dark by the fire but you were only four jerry when you came here have you remembered how she looked all these years said the authoress. Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation He said, “I can chop some wood today.” I said, “But I have a boy coming from the orphanage.” “I’m the boy.” “But you’re small.” “Size doesn’t matter, chopping wood,” he said. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 215
